control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, check LEFT then RIGHT; turn away from a side wall, otherwise call driveInTheDark; if the light is bright, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through a tunnel without hitting its walls, turning away when a wall is on its left or right.

the light is bright: it calls driveInTheDark
